instructions.content: NEVER wrap HSL values in `hsl()` inside `@theme inline`; keep `hsl()` in `:root` and reference it with `var()`
NEVER extract colours from `:hover` pseudo-states
NEVER use `prefers-color-scheme` media query colours as your base tokens
NEVER use `/tmp` for any artifact storage
NEVER save artifacts to `docs/` or any other location than the artifacts directory
NEVER copy the source site's actual CSS files or stylesheets into your project
NEVER use arbitrary Tailwind values (`bg-[#abc]`) for semantic colours
NEVER write source code before the theme documentation exists
NEVER pre-load all three reference files at once; load each when its stage begins
NEVER port obfuscated class names; extract computed values only
NEVER declare the port complete without a visual diff against the reference site
ALWAYS save artifacts under `.context/artifacts/<website-slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/` with a lowercase hyphenated slug
Choose the capture method by the decision tree: automated browser, then source inspection, then manual DevTools
If the site has no CSS custom properties, switch to computed-only extraction of key elements
For a SPA, scroll to the bottom and wait for network idle before extracting
Write colours.md, typography.md, spacing.md, components.md and overview.md under the theme directory before touching code
Document colours in a table with Token, Hex, HSL and Role columns
Record the source URL and extraction method in overview.md
Use the Token Decision Tree to assign ambiguous colours
Apply the theme as Tailwind v4 tokens, load the font with preconnect and display=swap, and use semantic classes in components
Extract in light mode, or document which mode was active in overview.md
Do not use the skill for login-walled sites, canvas-rendered UIs, obfuscated class names or designs you lack permission to replicate
